title.zh: 平台工人（向专员报告）条例 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Platform Workers (Notification of Commissioner) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 1 January 2025.
2. A notification to the Commissioner under section 8(1) or 9 of the Act must be made in the form and manner specified on the website of the Ministry of Manpower at https://www.mom.gov.sg.

heading.en: Notification that person satisfies criteria to be platform operator

text.en:
3.—(1) For the purposes of section 8(1)(a) of the Act, the prescribed time for a person to notify the Commissioner that the person satisfies the criteria to be a platform operator under section 4 of the Act is —
(a)14 days starting on the date on which the person satisfies section 4(1) of the Act, unless sub‑paragraph (b) applies; or
(b)in a case where the Commissioner determines, in accordance with section 10 of the Act, that the person is a platform operator — 14 days starting on the date the Commissioner informs the person of the Commissioner’s determination and requires the person to submit a notification under section 8(1) of the Act.
(2) For the purposes of section 8(2)(a) of the Act, a notification under section 8(1) of the Act must include —
(a)the identity particulars of the person;
(b)the person’s trade name, if different from the person’s registered name or full name;
(c)if the person is an individual — the person’s residential address;
(d)if the person is an entity — the address of the person’s principal place of business or registered office;
(e)the platform service or platform services provided by the person;
(f)the identity particulars and address of a contact person; and
(g)a telephone number and an email address by which the contact person mentioned in sub‑paragraph (f) can be contacted by the Commissioner.
(3) In paragraph (2), “identity particulars” means —
(a)for an individual who is a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore —
(i)the full name of the individual; and
(ii)the NRIC number of the individual;
(b)for an individual who is not a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore —
(i)the full name of the individual; and
(ii)the foreign identification number or (if the individual does not have a foreign identification number) passport number of the individual;
(c)for an entity that is formed, constituted or registered in Singapore under any written law —
(i)the registered name of the entity; and
(ii)the Unique Entity Number (UEN) of the entity; and
(d)for any other entity —
(i)the full name of the entity; and
(ii)the country under whose law the entity was formed, constituted or registered.

heading.en: Notification of cessation as platform operator

text.en: 4. For the purposes of section 9 of the Act, the prescribed time for a platform operator that ceases to be a platform operator within the meaning of section 4 of the Act to notify the Commissioner of that fact is 14 days starting on the date on which the platform operator ceases to satisfy section 4(1) of the Act.
